source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΕΝΔΕΚΑΤΟΣ. Περὶ ἱερωσύνης, καὶ ὅτι τύπος ἦν κατὰ νόμον τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ. {ΚΥΡ.} Σκηνῆς μὲν δὴ πέρι καὶ τῶν ἐπ' αὐτῇ κεχρησμῳδημένων, ἀποχρῶν ἡμῖν εὖ μάλα καὶ ἀστείως ἀπεξεσμένος
pass_a_gloss: LOGOS ENDEKATOS. Peri hierōsynēs / Concerning priesthood, kai hoti typos ēn / and that it was a type tēs en Christō / of the in Christ…
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK ELEVEN. Concerning priesthood, and that according to law it was a type of the one in Christ.

Cyril: Concerning the tent at least and the things oracled upon it, a word sufficient for us very well and gracefully polished unto spiritual thinness has been finished. And it would be fitting, as at least it seems to me—and you yourself also will somehow agree, I know—to take hold of the honors of priesthood, and again in what manner through the one in type and according to law the true is signified—that is, the one in Christ and through him sanctifying the sacred race, and I mean again those who have been flashed in faith, and who have been enriched with intimacy unto God, through at least having shared holy Spirit.
Palladius: For it would be fitting and very reasonably.
